# Genesis Entity Definitions — data-driven entity type configuration
# Columns: EntityType,Kind,AutoFillMin,DeathScenarioFile,DeadRetentionYears,MinAge,MaxAge,DefaultProperties,GenderWeights,LocationFollowsHero,DisplayStringUpper,DisplayStringLower,NamePoolFemale,NamePoolMale,NamePoolOther,SkinToneFemale,SkinToneMale,SkinToneOther,MaritalStatusWeights,NumChildrenWeights
"# Kind: ""npc"" or ""object"""
# AutoFillMin: minimum living population (0 = no auto-fill, NPC only)
# DeathScenarioFile: CSV filename in StreamingAssets to load on death (empty = none)
# DeadRetentionYears: years to keep dead entities (-1 = use container default)
# MinAge/MaxAge: age range for auto-fill NPCs (-1 = use default random)
# DefaultProperties: JSON-encoded default properties," e.g. {""role"":""volunteer""}"
"# GenderWeights: JSON {""male"":X",female:Y,other:Z} (empty = 50/50 male/female)
# LocationFollowsHero: true/false (default true)
# DisplayStringUpper/Lower: display text for tag resolution (empty = none)
"# NamePoolFemale/Male/Other: JSON arrays [""Name1""",Name2] (empty = random generation)
# SkinToneFemale/Male/Other: JSON arrays of skin tone strings (empty = country-derived)
"# MaritalStatusWeights: JSON {""single"":X",married:Y,...} (empty = none)
"# NumChildrenWeights: JSON {""0"":X",1:Y,...} (empty = none)
#   If any JSON field contains commas, wrap the whole field in double-quotes and
"#   escape internal quotes by doubling them: ""{""""key"""":""""val""""","k2"""":""""v2""""}"""
